description: Stadt Gelsenkirchen: Starkregengefahren (WMS) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by gdi.gelsenkirchen.de. Heavy rain in cities can pose dangers to residents and material goods due to uncontrolled, superficially draining water. With the increasing probability of heavy rain due to climate change, the potential for danger and damage is also growing in the coming decades. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "City of Gelsenkirchen: Heavy rain hazards (WMS)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Gefahr, WMS, Natur und Umwelt, Niederschlag, Stadt Gelsenkirchen, Wasser. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.govdata.de/dl-de/zero-2-0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
